about: Kandarin's pickpockets (Thieving 2 step T1b): East Ardougne's Knights of Ardougne, paladins (the streets and the castle's ground and first floors), heroes in the market and warriors (the pre-2022 warrior woman type, pickpocketed as a warrior); the Watchtower's watchmen on its first floor; the Tree Gnome Stronghold's gnomes, gnome women and gnome children. Each tile and type is mejrs's data_osrs NPCList_OSRS.json (NPCs seen on live, pre-Nov 2022). Wander ranges are guessed (5). Left out: West Ardougne and the Mourner Tunnels (Song of the Elves), Tree Gnome Village and the Battlefield of Khazard's gnomes, and the 2022 warrior types, which live has replaced the warrior women with (the same pocket).
